caption_L2L3: The graph shows a negative budget balance throughout the period.  For 2015-19 this was around -0.02 GDP and was falling.  It jumped sharply to around -0.13 GDP for 2020.  The negative balance is shown as reducing 2021 - 2023, then remaining at just over -0.02 GDP.
